facets.F1_correctness: Adds a minimal safe Rust parser skeleton behind WorkAreaTree that parses the committed pub-fn fixture into typed SourceFile/Function/token/block nodes with stable content-addressed node ids.
facets.F2_tests: Cargo and Buck2 unit tests exercise fixture parsing, typed node emission, WorkAreaTree node/child access, and missing-id/missing-shape failure behavior.
facets.F3_maintainability: The parser is isolated in governance/corpus/work-area-rust-parser and leaves the W1 work-area-tree-kernel trait crate as a seam-only contract.
facets.F4_compatibility: The new crate depends only on the existing work-area-tree-kernel seam and workspace sha2; root workspace membership is covered by the existing governance/corpus/* glob.
facets.F5_security: The implementation is safe Rust with #![forbid(unsafe_code)] and no filesystem, network, clock, or ambient environment reads in the parser path.
facets.F6_privacy: No user, tenant, customer, credential, or production data is introduced; the fixture is synthetic source code.
facets.F7_operability: Buck2 and Cargo targets are provided for the skeleton crate so future W2 consumers can depend on the parser through the standard build surfaces.
facets.F8_performance: The skeleton is one-pass over a tiny supported shape and stores deterministic BTreeMap-backed nodes; no runtime services or background work are introduced.
facets.F9_compliance: Traceability cites ADR-0517, ADR-0520, ADR-0521, and ADR-0530; no generated JSON faces are hand-edited.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a git revert of the new parser crate, its catalog row, Cargo.lock entry, and this evidence file.
facets.F11_observability: Parser errors are explicit RustParseError variants; tests prove unsupported shapes fail honestly rather than pretending full grammar support.
facets.F13_migration: This advances W2 AST parser work behind the locked W1 WorkAreaTree interface without changing the consumer trait contract.

scope.summary: Introduce the first WorkAreaTree-backed Rust parser skeleton with one fixture and typed nodes.
explicit_non_claims: No full Rust grammar support is claimed.
No Markdown parser, AST rewrite engine, affected-set engine, or SCM pipeline is introduced.
